text:
amal: Heads-up: security wants to roll a stricter KMS decrypt policy and enable ptls enforcement in NA/EU/APAC next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. This will remove broad legacy principals. Anyone seeing lingering old rotator/service accounts we should whitelist temporarily?

tessa: we ran a dry-run in staging and saw unwrap failures from svc/rotator-legacy in two clusters. sample log: `2026-03-20T11:05:12Z keystore unwrap: kms:DecryptAccessDenied principal=svc/rotator-legacy@eu-staging key=projects/redwood/locations/eu/keys/ks-main`

felix: that rotator is the one that seeds ephemeral client certs for the edge pods. If it fails, edge falls back to clientless TLS and we see auth mismatches. we saw a 4% increase in 401s during the dry-run.

jas: suggestion: use a 3-step rollout: (1) preflight mapping of all active SAs that call KMS, (2) apply conditional temporary decrypt grants for any missed SAs with an explicit expiry, (3) canary enforcement in one region for 30m.

dylan: +1. Also: include a correlation_id header in rotator unwrap calls and push it to KMS audit entry via request metadata so we can tie a decrypt event to a specific job run.

tessa: quick snippet we used in staging: ```python
req_id = os.getenv('ROTATOR_CORR_ID', str(uuid4()))
resp = kms_client.decrypt(name=key, ciphertext=cipher, metadata={"request_id": req_id})
logger.info(f"unwrap ok job={job} req_id={req_id} sa={service_account}")
```

amal: good. Operational requirements: any temporary KMS grant must have a condition: `request.time < timestamp("2026-04-02T00:00:00Z")`, a change ticket, and a reminder to remove. No open-ended grants.

felix: can we also add a metric `ptls.client_cert_absent` emitted by the edge layer when a client cert is not presented? That would let us alarm before user-visible auth errors spike.

jas: set canary thresholds: ptls.client_cert_absent > 5/min for 5m or keystore.unwrap_errors > 3/min in region => rollback.

dylan: I'll draft an RBAC hardening checklist: inventory SAs, validate decrypt with each principal, add correlation_id to unwrap calls, set conditional expiries, run 30m canary, verify audit logs, then global enforcement. ETA: tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: change-note: created ticket SEC-2026 for temporary KMS grants; monitor channels will receive alerts during canary window.

amal: action items: dylan=playbook draft + circulate; tessa=run SA inventory and attach to ticket; felix=add ptls.client_cert_absent metric and canary alert; jas=prepare rollback commands (re-grant or rollback infra PR). We'll schedule the enforcement after sign-off. Thanks. :thumbsup:
